Ravi: Quick sync 10xBank wants a 2-week POC but insist EU-only processing for EU tenants. Explicitly: inference, logs, model artifacts, and telemetry must not leave EU. No US subprocessors for those tenants.
Tess: Understood. Do we have a customer-ready subprocessor spreadsheet and cert links? Legal asked for SOC2/ISO chains.
Omar: We have an internal matrix. Infra note: EU primary is Frankfurt (GCP), warm DR in Amsterdam. APAC nodes in Singapore. Some ops/observability vendors default to US endpoints (Datadog, Sentry).
Ravi: They said any telemetry to US is unacceptable. Can we guarantee zero US egress for a short POC?
Leah: Yes, but only via Dedicated or Private. Hosted product depends on central control-plane components in the US. For a Hosted POC we'd need an explicit legal exception.
Tess: If we require Dedicated, customer will ask for Hosted-equivalent credits. Any quick pricing delta for a 2-week EU Dedicated POC (2 GPUs)?
Omar: Rough ballpark: ,000 USD vendor-equivalent ~ (that's about k) but realistic: $4k-$7k depending on reserved node sizing + ops support. Private setup + KMS adds setup fees. Finance sign-off needed.
Leah: We can run a temporary EU-dedicated namespace with telemetry and external agents disabled. Example minimal config:
```
routing_policy: REGION_PIN_EU
external_telemetry: DISABLED
excluded_subprocessors: [datadog, sentry, honeycomb]
kms_region: europe-west1
auto_failover: false
```
Tess: Great. Also need the subproc matrix with vendor cert links (SOC2/ISO) and a short contract clause we can put into the SOW.
Leah: Draft clause: "During the POC term, Redwood will enforce EU region pinning for the tenant, disable specified external telemetry, and exclude listed sub-processors. No automatic cross-border processing will occur without prior written consent."
compliance-bot: Compliance pack request recorded: REQ-4312. Attach SOC2/ISO docs via secure portal link after approval.
Ravi: I'll present two options to the customer: (A) Hosted POC (fast) but cannot meet EU-only telemetry requirement without exception; (B) EU Dedicated POC (meets residency, higher cost, 3-5 business day lead). Include draft clause and cost estimates.
Tess: Looping in Legal and SolutionsEng when you reply. Keep me on cc for pricing negotiations.
Omar: I'll export the subproc matrix and mark vendors as 'EU-hosted', 'US-only', or 'excluded' and include cert links. ETA EOD.
Leah: I'll prepare the runbook and ops handoff timeline for post-POC (3 business days for handover if POC succeeds).
Ravi: Thanks team 44D. I'll update 10xBank and schedule follow-ups.
